title: Joint Resolution to Acknowledge the 100th Anniversary of the January 17, 1893 Overthrow of the Kingdom of Hawaii
publisher_or_archive: United States Government Printing Office, 107 Stat. 1510, Public Law 103-150
summary: Official joint resolution passed by both houses of the US Congress and signed into law by President Bill Clinton, formally offering an apology to Native Hawaiians for the overthrow of the Kingdom of Hawaii on January 17, 1893, acknowledging that US diplomatic and military representatives participated directly in the illegal insurrection without the consent of the Native Hawaiian people.
